name: application-import-wizard
title: Import Wizard
description: Multi-step upload, column-mapping, and preview flow for importing spreadsheet or CSV data, with per-column field mapping and a row-count review before confirming.
useWhen: Letting a user upload a spreadsheet or CSV and map its columns to fields in your data model before importing.
Showing a row-count preview and skip warnings before committing an import.
The import flow is specific enough (file → mapping → review) that the generic application-stepper-wizard shell needs this specialized content.
avoidWhen: The import format is fixed and never needs column mapping — a plain file uploader is simpler.
The flow has generic steps unrelated to file import — use application-stepper-wizard instead.
Import happens instantly with no preview needed — skip straight to a confirmation toast instead of a multi-step flow.
responsiveBehavior: The wizard card has a fixed max width and stacks its step header vertically once the step labels no longer fit horizontally; the preview table scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.
accessibility: The current step is marked with aria-current='step' on its indicator.
The skip/warning message is not the only signal a column is unmapped — style and copy communicate it together.
The preview table uses real th/scope='col' headers so screen readers announce column names per cell.

variants.title: Map columns step
variants.description: Second step of the wizard: match each source column to a destination field, with unresolved mappings flagged as a warning.
accessibility: Unmapped fields are flagged with red border and text together with the warning copy, not color alone.

variants.title: Map columns step (Dark)
variants.description: Column-mapping wizard step adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Warning and unmapped-field colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Review step
variants.description: Final step of the wizard: a preview table of the first rows, a count of remaining rows, and a skip-reason warning before confirming the import.
accessibility: The import button states the exact row count that will be imported, not just a generic 'Import' label.

variants.title: Review step (Dark)
variants.description: Import review step adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Table header and row text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
